snippet.title: Besmirch - Official Gameplay Trailer | Indie Horror Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Besmirch is a pixel art survival farming sim that forces you to stealthily plant crops while avoiding monsters and unwanted visitors at night. You’ll also be able to socialize with the local city-fold, but can you trust them? Besmirch will be released on PC in 2026.
